**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve explicit strategy-route ownership over research**

When the interpreter returns `intent="strategy_drafting"`/`"backtest_execution"` or `semantic_turn_act="new_idea"` together with an erroneous `research_query`, this predicate does not treat those explicit strategy signals as conflicting owners. If the draft only has a default-provenance strategy type plus reference fields, as with “Test META from 2020 through 2024,” `primary_research_query()` accepts the query and the research rail answers statistics instead of producing the requested backtest setup. Derive this check from the canonical strategy-route ownership predicate rather than maintaining a partial act list.
